verification.command: focused loader query-budget, transformation and cache tests
verification.summary: 21 loader tests passed. Cold 1-slot and 16-slot reads use exactly three static domain queries, warm reads use one revision query, cache limits and dependency invalidation hold, explicit source evidence is required, structured stats are not parsed from display text or double-applied, invalid facts remain fail-closed, and both package and direct server runtime imports succeed. The complete Phase 1-2B contract suite passed 80 tests.
Two store tests passed: one cursor and transaction are marked read-only before loader delegation, the bounded cache is reused, successful reads commit and transient loader failures roll back.

verification.command: six resolved-snapshot facade and runtime-authority parity tests
verification.summary: Six facade/runtime-authority tests passed: contract/readiness/revision gates fail closed, serializer input overrides forged client gear facts, golden profile lines match, the current profile path does not call the facade, all 40 specs match current armor/weapon/hand policy, and SimC runtime revision is required.
726 current facade, PostgreSQL store and backend regression tests passed; existing profile, public payload, health, task and simulator behavior remains unchanged.
1148 Python tests passed with 1 skipped; compileall and Strict Harness passed.
365 Node tests and 1148 Python tests passed with 1 skipped; all 127 syntax, JSON, Harness and diff commands passed.

verification.command: static SQL/query-budget and dormant-consumer inspection plus Python compile
verification.summary: All five touched Python modules compiled. The loader contains exactly three cursor execute sites and three static SQL markers with no dynamic SQL identifiers; Resolver/Ledger have zero PG/facade coupling, and the store/facade helpers have definitions and test callers only.

No unresolved findings. Review caught and fixed three fail-closed defects with red-to-green tests: structured variant stats were double-applied, absent source status defaulted to verified instead of unknown, and missing or invalid structured stat facts were sanitized into an allowed empty map. The first candidate attempt then exposed a direct-script import mismatch; production was immediately rolled back to the verified Phase 2A runtime, a reproducing test was added, and the loader now supports package and server-directory imports. Review also confirmed bounded cache/query behavior, compatibility manifest wording, one PG boundary and no route, frontend, Worker, write, migration, sync, cleanup or Catalyst activation.

risks.detail: Cold reads must execute exactly three static domain queries for one or sixteen slots; warm hits may execute only the revision query.
Cache keys bind the full dependency and selection identities, enforce entry and serialized-byte limits, and never retain incomplete transient authority.
The store method and facade helpers remain dormant; no current route, profile call site, frontend or Worker may consume them in Slice 2B.
compatibility-pg-live-v1 cannot be described or consumed as the formal Phase 4 Active Season Manifest.

summary: Slice 2B implementation is locally verified: the bounded PostgreSQL Authority Context loader, read-only store method, server-owned runtime authority and resolved-snapshot parity facade are complete and dormant; candidate deployment against the live PostgreSQL schema is the next gate.
